item.title: School Navigation!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Xwind
  • 発売日: 2005-05-27
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: スクールなびげーしょん!
  • 英語名: School Navigation!

あらすじ

An anthology consisting of multiple parts:

  • Youkoso, Shiritsu Seijuujika Gakuen e! An illustrated audio drama about a transfer student being introduced to a wide variety of school clubs.

  • Happy Day. A bonus episode for the previous audio drama. Contains a voice actor Q&A at the end.

  • mislead Michibikareshi Hikari. A visual novel about two orphan siblings fighting demons.

  • A preview for an unreleased game titled Kaze ga Fuku Machi.

  • A collection of illustrations titled Kaze no Tayori, accompanied by narration.
